nodes.label: skillgen-check pre-commit hook
nodes.rationale: Local anti-drift guard: skill files under graphify/ are generated from fragments in tools/skillgen/, so a hand-edit to a generated file must fail the same way CI does.

nodes.label: graphify agent rules
nodes.rationale: Agents should read the graph report and wiki before answering architecture questions, and re-run `graphify update` after code edits because AST-only updates cost no API credits.

nodes.label: graphify Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Each stage lives in its own module and stages communicate through plain dicts and NetworkX graphs — no shared state and no side effects outside graphify-out/.

nodes.label: extract(paths, *, root=None)
nodes.rationale: Root should always be passed explicitly: node ids and source_file values derive from it, and an inferred root is the common parent of the passed list rather than the project root, which leaks machine-specific path segments into ids.

nodes.label: collect_files(target)
nodes.rationale: Lives in extract.py rather than detect.py because it expands a directory into the path list extract() consumes.

nodes.label: cluster(G)
nodes.rationale: The graph is not mutated; clustering returns a community_id -> node id mapping.

nodes.label: analyze.py helpers
nodes.rationale: A set of sibling functions rather than one entry point — there is no single analyze() function.

nodes.label: export.to_* functions
nodes.rationale: One function per output format (json, html, obsidian, svg, graphml, canvas, cypher).

nodes.label: security.py guards
nodes.rationale: All external input passes through one module so URL, path and label validation cannot be bypassed by individual callers.

nodes.label: validate_extraction / assert_valid
nodes.rationale: Enforces the extraction schema before build() consumes it.

nodes.label: Confidence labels (EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS)
nodes.rationale: AMBIGUOUS relationships are flagged for human review in GRAPH_REPORT.md rather than dropped.

nodes.label: Adding a new language extractor
nodes.rationale: New languages go in their own module under graphify/extractors/ while extract.py re-exports them, so the existing extractors can be ported out incrementally.

nodes.label: tests/test_architecture_doc.py
nodes.rationale: Imports every symbol named in the module table so the doc cannot drift from the code.

nodes.label: graphify benchmark harness
nodes.rationale: Competing systems run as adapters inside graphify's own harness so every system sees the same model, token budget and grader.

nodes.label: Temporal suite (689 weekly AST checkpoints)
nodes.rationale: Built deterministically with no LLM so 15 years of checkpoints can be produced at zero credit cost.

nodes.label: Kimi K2.6 key-fact judge
nodes.rationale: Every verdict cites a verbatim quote so grades are auditable rather than one opaque score; blind-validated against a second independent judge (90.6% agreement, kappa 0.81) because most published memory benchmarks disclose no judge validation.

nodes.label: Fairness rules
nodes.rationale: One model for every LLM role, one shared local embedder, identical token budgets and a per-run spend ledger, so cross-system numbers are comparable.

nodes.label: Cost and token economics
nodes.rationale: Graph construction uses tree-sitter plus a local embedder, so indexing costs zero LLM credits where most memory systems pay a per-document ingest cost.

nodes.label: supermemory (baseline system)
nodes.rationale: Its self-host locks in a 768-d English-only embedder rather than the shared BGE-m3, which confounds its retrieval-recall number.

nodes.label: Classic retrieval baselines (BM25, dense RAG, hybrid RRF)
nodes.rationale: Baselines retrieve from the same harness-built index, so they incur no separate ingest cost.

nodes.label: Graph shrink guard
nodes.rationale: The guard now diffs the on-disk baseline by node identity and refuses any loss from a source that was neither re-extracted nor pruned, because reading the post-replace node count let a broken partial re-extract destroy nodes silently.

nodes.label: Incremental extraction / update
nodes.rationale: Merge is tier-aware and stale-source pruning is fail-closed: a source missing from the scan is pruned only when its exclusion is provable, otherwise kept with a warning.

nodes.label: Node id normalization and portability
nodes.rationale: Ids are kept root-relative, POSIX-separated and casefold/NFKC-stable to a fixpoint so graphs stay byte-comparable across machines, clones and platforms without re-keying existing graphs.

nodes.label: JS/TS binding shadowing for indirect_call
nodes.rationale: Catch, arrow, loop, nested-function-expression and external-import bindings each shadow their own scope so a local name cannot fabricate an INFERRED indirect_call to an unrelated same-named callable.

nodes.label: Typed-receiver member-call resolution
nodes.rationale: Member calls resolve only with receiver-type, import or self/cls/super evidence, and typing is tracked per method/lexical scope, so name-only matches cannot fabricate high-confidence calls edges or god nodes.

nodes.label: Edge direction recovery via _src/_tgt markers
nodes.rationale: Direction is recovered from stored _src/_tgt markers rather than persisted endpoint order, so older graphs and merge-driver output still render true direction in path, explain and callflow.

nodes.label: Hyperedge persistence and merging
nodes.rationale: Hyperedges are read from both top-level and nested slots, members are normalized to ids, id-less hyperedges are tolerated, and dedup rewires merged-away members to the survivor so groupings never lose participants.

nodes.label: Chunk retry, bisect and hollow-response handling
nodes.rationale: A timeout bisects the chunk while a hollow (parses but symbol-free) reply is retried with backoff instead, so an overwhelmed backend is not billed for re-splitting a chunk it already answered.

nodes.label: Backend response parsing (thinking/reasoning blocks)
nodes.rationale: The first text block is read and JSON is recovered from mixed narration, preferring an object carrying the extraction keys, so reasoning-first models are not silently dropped.

nodes.label: Semantic cache behaviour
nodes.rationale: A corrupt entry is surfaced and re-extracted rather than being a silent miss that re-bills the LLM every run; symlinks are not collapsed when keying so aliases keep distinct identities.

nodes.label: gitignore / graphifyignore handling
nodes.rationale: Ignore files are decoded UTF-8-first then by BOM then host codepage and matched NFC-normalized, and git-tracked files are never dropped, matching git's own behaviour.

nodes.label: Export robustness (GraphML, Obsidian, wiki, HTML)
nodes.rationale: Each exporter scrubs only the characters its own format forbids and budgets filenames against the full destination path, so non-ASCII labels survive and a long output directory cannot abort an export mid-write.

nodes.label: Git hook integration
nodes.rationale: Hooks bake a committed .graphifyrc viz_node_limit as a shell default so a project-wide limit survives regeneration while an explicit env var still wins.

nodes.label: MCP server compatibility
nodes.rationale: Handlers bind via the 1.x decorators or the 2.x on_* constructor callbacks picked at runtime, lifting the mcp<2 cap that a removed low-level API had forced.

nodes.label: graphify query
nodes.rationale: It names the graph and node count it opened, never drops edges from a complete answer, and reports an honest over-budget notice instead of silently returning an oversized payload.

nodes.label: graphify affected
nodes.rationale: Seeds resolve against the repo root derived from the graph's own location rather than the CWD, so a blast-radius query works from any directory.

nodes.label: graphify explain
nodes.rationale: The exact tier compares the diacritic-folded id and the trigram index carries the folded form, so an id printed by explain can be fed back into explain.

nodes.label: graphify install / uninstall
nodes.rationale: The .graphify_version stamp advances only for the platform actually rewritten, so an untouched platform keeps a truthful staleness warning.

nodes.label: Node dedup and fuzzy merging
nodes.rationale: A one-token label difference is judged on the differing tokens rather than whole-label similarity, so distinct entities stay separate while typo and whitespace variants still collapse; --no-dedup lets operators keep fuzzy-matched symbols apart entirely.

nodes.label: JavaScript/TypeScript extractor
nodes.rationale: Owners are minted only for identifiers proven to be object-literal bindings in the enclosing function, so factory members are captured without reintroducing the phantom-owner flood.

nodes.label: C# extractor
nodes.rationale: partial class merging keys on assembly plus namespace and name so same-named types in separate projects stay distinct.

nodes.label: C/C++ extractor
nodes.rationale: C++/CLI sources are normalized to plain C++ before parsing so tree-sitter does not fabricate phantom symbols from ERROR nodes.

nodes.label: Java extractor
nodes.rationale: The type resolver runs before the unique-label stub rewire and parks imported-but-external types on their fully-qualified name, so a local class and a same-named external annotation stay distinct.

nodes.label: Go extractor
nodes.rationale: Exported and unexported symbols differing only by case get distinct ids because Go's visibility rules are case-sensitive; only the Go extractor's id assignment changed so other languages' ids do not move.

nodes.label: Swift extractor
nodes.rationale: Ambiguous or non-concrete return types stay unresolved rather than guessing.

nodes.label: Ruby extractor
nodes.rationale: Mixin resolution is scoped and lexical so a qualified external name cannot bind to a local module of the same last segment.

nodes.label: SQL extractor
nodes.rationale: A WITH cte name is scoped to its query rather than treated as a table, so it cannot mint a stub that binds to an unrelated symbol.

nodes.label: Bash extractor
nodes.rationale: A `..` on a guessed base is rejected and a tracked-base `..` cannot walk past the base's parent, so a hostile corpus cannot make the extractor stat an out-of-tree file.

nodes.label: OCaml extractor
nodes.rationale: External qualified calls are kept as a distinct target labelled by the full path so they cannot bind to a same-named local value.

nodes.label: Markdown extractor
nodes.rationale: Node ids are unchanged by the node_kind/frontmatter feature so existing markdown graphs are not re-keyed.

nodes.label: Partial-parse warning
nodes.rationale: Fires only when recovery plausibly cost symbols and reports the surviving symbol count, because tiny fully-recovered constructs set the grammar's error flag and a hardcoded issue citation misdirected reporters.

nodes.label: graph.json determinism
nodes.rationale: Field and collection order are stable across a read-rebuild round-trip so re-running update on an unchanged graph produces a byte-identical file and graphify-out/ stops showing as dirty.

nodes.label: Rubric confidence scores on AST edges
nodes.rationale: INFERRED edges carry a relation-keyed rubric score (uses 0.95, indirect/unresolved calls 0.85) and the default moved 0.5->0.55 so no edge lands on the rubric-forbidden 0.5.

nodes.label: Relation specificity on edge merge
nodes.rationale: The builder keeps the more specific relation when two edges connect the same pair, because a generic references/uses could otherwise downgrade a real calls edge out of the call graph.

nodes.label: Bedrock backend
nodes.rationale: Honors GRAPHIFY_API_TIMEOUT and GRAPHIFY_MAX_RETRIES instead of botocore's silent 60s default.

nodes.label: API extraction prompt
nodes.rationale: Instructs backends to capture the per-node rationale attribute so API-backed extraction matches the skill path instead of silently dropping design intent.

nodes.label: Platform skill generation
nodes.rationale: The Windows variant emits PowerShell rather than bash steps, with step parity enforced by a generator check.
